question: Select from the following the biotic component of an ecosystem.
solution:
__
 
• **Decomposer **__is the biotic component of an ecosystem 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Decomposers **are the second most important organisms after the producers.
 
• These decomposers also help the producers to produce their food too.
 
• They are the second most important organisms because they decompose all the remaining organic matter.
 
• They also provide nutrients that the producers use to produce food.​ 

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**Biotic components

 
• They are made up of organisms, living organisms, dead organisms, and the waste products of these and are classified on how they obtain energy.
 
• Autotrophs: these organisms feed themselves and are thus known as self-feeders.
 
• They prepare their food using **sunlight, water, CO₂ and nutrients.**
 
• They are also known as producers.
 
• Heterotrophs: these organisms can’t produce their food and thus rely on the other organisms for their energy requirements.
 
• They are also called consumers as they consume food from the producers

 

Abiotic components

 
• They are usually the non-living components of our ecosystem which are,** sun, rainfall, temperature, air, and soil.**
 
• The abiotic components are affected by many things such as **altitude, location and seasons.**
 
• 
 
The abiotic factors change from **weather to weather, climate to climate, season to season and place to place**
